title.narrative: Rocky Mountain Institute - coal phase-out in Indonesia and Vietnam

description.narrative:
Support energy transition and specifically coal phase-out in Vietnam and Indonesia by:
1) collection of power plant and utility operational and financial data including information on coal supply arrangements; 2) deep dialogue and assessment of the key challenges and opportunities for utilities, customers, developers, financiers, labour, and the government; 3) building relationships and aligning on priorities with key stakeholders 4) set of 5-6 conceptual financial mechanisms tailored to prioritized coal plants in 1-2 target provinces; 5) produce a report with recommendations.
